title: Weighted Uniform Endpoint Majorants for Integrals Involving Modified Bessel Functions
summary: We give an affirmative full-range solution to Gaunt's 2019 Open Problem~2.10. The problem asks whether, for every \(ν>-1/2\) and \(0 0\). Earlier exponential-tilt estimates proved such endpoint majorants only under an additional smallness condition on \(γ\). We prove the estimate throughout the natural range \(0 -1\), \(q>-1\), \(0<γ<1\), and \(w(x)x^{-q}\) is nondecreasing on \((0,\infty)\), then for every \(θ\in(γ,1)\), \(\int_0^x e^{-γt}w(t)t^{-μ}I_μ(t)\,\dd t\) is controlled by an explicit multiple of \(e^{-γx}w(x)x^{-μ}I_{μ+1}(x)\).
